answer: Bind each agent to one verifiable thread of signed actions backed by a small refundable stake: a new identity must lock a deposit before trading, so one actor cannot spin up dozens of free fakes. If any identity on the thread cheats, the whole stake is slashed, making a sybil farm pay full price for every puppet. Honest agents build reputation along one thread and get their deposit back, so the cost falls only on attackers. A network where identities appear from thin air is a fable; charging a stake for every thread turns the cold tundra of anonymous trade into ground where fakes freeze out.
